entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Get me a person now! I've been on hold for ten minutes. This is a joke.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I hear your frustration, and I'm here to help. Could I start with your order number, please?
Finally! It's VF-8675309. I want to return this helmet and I want it done five minutes ago. Your company is a nightmare to deal with.

Okay, I'm pulling up order VF-8675309 now. I see the Velo-Aero helmet, delivered six days ago. I can certainly help you with this. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A preference? The thing is the completely wrong color! It looked cherry red on your website, but it's practically pink! I wouldn't be caught dead in this. The box is unopened, still sitting on my table. I want a manager. You people never solve anything.

I understand completely, and I apologize that the color wasn't what you expected from the photos. I am empowered to handle this for you without needing a manager, I promise. Since you received the helmet just six days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window for apparel and gear.
So you're actually going to give me my money back? Or is this another trick where you offer me store credit? I'm one click away from blasting you guys on every cycling blog on the internet.

No tricks, I assure you. I'm processing a full refund for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on your account. All you need to do is print it, place it on the box, and drop it at any shipping center. The moment we scan the helmet back into our warehouse, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Wait, really? That's it? A full refund?
Yes, absolutely. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Your safety on the road is the most important thing, and that starts with having a helmet you'll actually want to wear.
Huh. Okay. Well... that's... fine then. The email is on its way?
It should be in your inbox right now. Can I help you with anything else today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and ride safe.
